headline: US Solar Module Maker T1 Energy Receives Commerce Department Cell Import Waiver
summary: Texas-based T1 Energy announced it received a Department of Commerce waiver to import up to 1.725 GW of solar cells for module assembly.
why: Import waivers for solar components ease supply bottlenecks for domestic renewable energy manufacturers facing tariff constraints.

impacts.name: T1 Energy
impacts.why: Receiving an import waiver secures vital component inputs for its module assembly operations, boosting production capacity.
